name: TNA Solutions
lm_rationale: Credora Partners — 1 SME IPO in 2026, 1 positive listing (100%), +40.00% avg listing-day gain (chittorgarh 2026 SME tracker); meets the Strong thresholds on a single listing, so the record is thin.
net_proceeds: ₹20.00 Cr funds working capital and ₹6.76 Cr funds civil construction and plant and machinery for a new manufacturing unit at Dhamnod, Madhya Pradesh, with the balance to general corporate purposes. The issue is entirely fresh; there is no OFS.
key_risks: Top 10 customers made up 83.82% of FY26 revenue (the largest 23.27%), exports were 52.03%, and operating cash flow was negative in all three years, at ₹(18.47) Cr in FY26.
market_moat: It sells to global retailers, importers and domestic brands under a B2B model (99.60% of FY26 revenue) and does cutting, stitching, embroidery, finishing and quality control in-house at Indore. It also has a small own brand, Ambra Linens, launched in 2022.
management: Promoters Ambuj Jain, Ayush Jain and Tanu Jain; 68.68% pre-issue promoter and promoter-group holding drops to 50.48% post-issue.
prose_business: TNA Solutions makes home textiles in Indore: sheet sets, pillow covers, towels, comforters, quilts, dohars and mattress protectors. It buys greige and processed fabric, outsources weaving, dyeing and printing, and does the cutting, stitching and finishing itself. Exports were 52.03% of FY26 revenue, to markets including the US, UAE, South Africa and the UK.
highlight_dev: A new unit at Plot I-30, Jetapur, Smart Industrial Park, Dhamnod, funded with ₹6.76 Cr of proceeds, is to raise installed capacity by 35,39,878 metres a year, from 52,23,386 to 87,63,264 metres.
sector_outlook: The RHP's industry section projects India's home textile market to grow at a 7.08% CAGR over 2026–2031 to US$16.76 billion.
gov_scheme: The company received an Industrial Development Grant of ₹39,82,508 under the Madhya Pradesh MSME Promotion Scheme, 2021 for its existing Indore unit, with two instalments (₹19,91,254) received so far. It has not applied for any subsidy on the new unit.
peer_sentence: At 14.89x post-issue EPS, TNA is priced well below the RHP peer set of VTM Limited (41.84x) and Faze Three Limited (37.35x), whose industry average is 39.60x.
verdict_reason: 14.89x post-issue P/E against a 39.60x RHP peer average, 1.94x P/BV, and fully growth-led use of proceeds
why: Revenue from operations rose from ₹35.85 Cr in FY24 to ₹104.59 Cr in FY26 and PAT from ₹2.69 Cr to ₹9.58 Cr, with ROE of 32.60% and ROCE of 42.84%. At ₹70 the issue is priced at 14.89x post-issue EPS and 1.94x post-issue NAV, far below the RHP peer average of 39.60x. All of the proceeds are fresh money, for working capital (₹20.00 Cr) and a new unit (₹6.76 Cr). Credora Partners' only 2026 SME listing gained 40.00%, but one listing is a thin record. The main risk is funding: D/E is 1.29, DSCR fell to 0.69, operating cash flow has been negative for three years, and top 10 customers are 83.82% of revenue.
suggestion: Apply for the long term, since valuation is cheap against the RHP peers. Keep the size modest because cash flow is negative and customers are concentrated.
documents: drhp-cache/tna-solutions-rhp.pdf (RHP dated 24 Sep 2026, 379 PDF pages / 346 numbered, from credorapartners.com)
discrepancies: chittorgarh NAV 119.80 / P/BV 0.58 uses pre-bonus NAV (4:1 bonus on 14 Jul 2026); RHP post-issue NAV at cap is ₹36.16, so P/BV = 70/36.16 = 1.94 used (pre-issue bonus-adjusted NAV 3,593.98 lakh / 150 lakh shares = ₹23.96 would give 2.92)
chittorgarh RoNW 26.67% (PAT ÷ closing net worth) is not an RHP figure; RHP RoNW/ROE on average equity = 32.60%
chittorgarh pre-IPO EPS 6.39 / P/E 10.95 vs RHP FY26 EPS ₹6.41, so P/E pre = 70/6.41 = 10.92 used
chittorgarh promoter pre 68.69% vs RHP 68.68% (promoters 68.62% + group 0.06%); post 50.48% matches the RHP
chittorgarh PAT margin 9.16% and EBITDA margin 12.12% are RHP KPIs on revenue from operations; brief formula on total income gives 8.68% and 11.48%
Company was an LLP until conversion (incorporated as company 23 Jun 2024); FY24 figures are LLP-period and FY24 EPS is N.A.
RHP peer note says peer P/Es are 'reproduced from the Peer Financial Template supplied by the user', a drafting artefact; peer P/Es are quoted verbatim as disclosed (market price as of 22 Sep 2026)
